unitNotes.FIX-LOCKID: RS26 remainder (tracks/CORE/contracts/actions-sos.md lines 111 and 130). Store.status() gains lockId: an opaque string while a lock row exists, null when none; a NEW value whenever the lock row is created (set PIN), replaced (change PIN; replaceAll or import that writes a lock row, even one that carried an id; reset then set) or removed (remove PIN, erase: null); never derived from the PIN, salt or check (random bytes). Kept in the lock row itself, so it survives a reload unchanged and a second Store over the same storage (another tab) reads the new value after its load. Node memory mode the same. store.test.mjs: each transition changes it; unchanged across reload; null without a lock; no PIN, salt or check text inside it; a second store instance sees the change. No other Store API change; an old export without the field imports with a fresh id.
unitNotes.FIX-A11Y-N: N1, N2, Q-a of tracks/CORE/contracts/core.md lines 117-119 (ui-core.js UI.form custom field focus, about :370-380). N1: role=group is written only on a plain div or span; a node with an implicit role (ul, ol, table, svg, fieldset and the rest) keeps it, still named by aria-labelledby. N2: a contenteditable node counts as a control: no tabindex -1, no role=group. Q-a: a native control (input, select, textarea, button) returned as the custom field's node gets aria-labelledby the field label's id when the page named it no other way. Tests in store.test.mjs's UI.form block, each red before.
